title: Single-stage, 980-nm-pumped C-band EDFA of Perin et al. (2019), ref. [124]
model: Spectrally resolved Giles-Desurvire model with forward and backward ASE (end-to-end case study, Section 5.7)

device.host: Er-doped silica (commercial C-band fiber, host composition not stated in the source)

reference_plane: as reported by the source; component losses between the fiber ends and the measurement ports are not stated and must be confirmed
notes: Spectral coefficients digitized from the vector graphics of Fig. 7 of arXiv:1803.07905 (data/perin2019_giles_coefficients.csv); scalar values read from the text of the arXiv version. Before publication the authors confirm every value against the journal version of record (J. Lightwave Technol. 37(9), 2076-2085, 2019).

L.applies_to: length of the Er-doped fiber ('a single 8-m-long EDF')

verification.note: value and unit confirmed against arXiv:1803.07905v3 on 2026-11-17; version of record not checked

lambda_p.note: the source states a forward pump 'near 980 nm'; the exact wavelength is not given

alpha_p.applies_to: absorption coefficient at the pump wavelength

verification.note: value and unit confirmed against arXiv:1803.07905v3 on 2026-11-17; version of record not checked

g_p.applies_to: no stimulated emission at the 980 nm pump (fast 4I11/2 -> 4I13/2 relaxation); stated by the source, a modeling assumption

verification.note: value and unit confirmed against arXiv:1803.07905v3 on 2026-11-17; version of record not checked
value and unit confirmed against arXiv:1803.07905v3 on 2026-11-17; version of record not checked
value and unit confirmed against arXiv:1803.07905v3 on 2026-11-17; version of record not checked; the source writes 'tau approximately 10 ms'

uncertainty.note: tau 'approximately 10 ms'; r_Er and N_t without stated uncertainty

source.digitization_method: vector-path extraction and axis calibration (digitize_perin2019.py, stages 1 and 2; raw vector paths in data/raw_perin2019)

verification.consistency: at 300 K a single crossing wavelength of 1533.5 nm (median of the pointwise values over 1500-1565 nm) reproduces g* from alpha with Equation (1) within 1.6 % over 1500-1565 nm; a free-temperature fit over 1470-1569 nm gives 293.2 K (crossing wavelength 1533.5 nm) and a maximum deviation of 0.065 %, i.e. within 0.07 % (script values: e2e_perin.mccumber_test, Fig12_end_to_end_results.json, L1)

max_dev_of_gstar_300K_at_median_lambda_x.note: median crossing wavelength of the full table (1470-1569 nm) applied to all three ranges (2.58, 2.09 and 1.96 %); the script stores the 1470-1569 nm value. The consistency statement uses the median of the 1500-1565 nm range instead (1.58 %).

mccumber_test.interpretation: g* equals the McCumber transform of alpha at about 293 K to digitization precision, so g* was most likely computed from alpha by the source (not stated there). The test confirms the internal consistency of the card and the digitization; it is not independent evidence for the emission spectrum (circular for this card).

uncertainty.coverage: not stated; used as one standard deviation
uncertainty.source: [124] App. A: 'The experimental error in these values was estimated independently to be about 5%'

NA.applies_to: numerical aperture of the EDF; not used by the Giles model (the overlap is contained in alpha and g*), needed by simulators that compute the overlap from the waveguide

l_bg.applies_to: background (excess) loss of the EDF at all wavelengths; set to zero by the source in its simulations; no measured value given

fit.target: measured gain and ASE of [124], Fig. 8

source.locator: Appendix A: 'The nominal experimentally measured values have been scaled up by 8% to achieve the best fit between theory and experiment'

coef_scale_source.applies_to: scale applied by the source to its nominal measured alpha and g* for its theory curves; whether Fig. 7 shows nominal or scaled values is not stated. NOT applied in this card: the digitized Fig. 7 spectra are used as published (scale 1).

verification.note: at the operating points of Fig. 8 a common 8 % scale changes the mean gain by less than 0.01 dB and the spectral shape by 0.30 dB RMS (e2e_perin.source_model_study)

reference_data: data/perin2019_fig8_gain_ase.json (measured gain and ASE at six pump powers, 40 x -13 dBm)
source_version: arXiv:1803.07905v3 (18 Feb 2019), Appendix A, Figs. 7-8, Table 1; version of record J. Lightwave Technol. 37(9), 2076-2085 (2019), doi:10.1109/JLT.2019.2897831, not checked

waveguide.overlap: contained in alpha(lambda) and g*(lambda); not separable without the waveguide data

required_by_model: operating point (pump power and channel powers at the fiber ends)
missing: reference planes of pump power, channel power, gain and ASE (component losses of WDM coupler, isolators, splices and connectors not stated)
background loss of the EDF (the source sets 0 in its simulations)
whether Fig. 7 shows the nominal or the 8 %-scaled coefficients
core radius, cut-off wavelength and mode-field diameter
effective noise bandwidth of the OSA and the ASE measurement method

data_license: digitized from the arXiv figures of [124]; redistribution of the digitized curves to be agreed with the source authors

history.change: fields added (NA, l_bg, coef_scale_source, uncertainty fields, McCumber test record, waveguide, reference_operating_points, completeness, source_version, data_licence); source locators corrected to Appendix A / Fig. 7 caption of arXiv v3; g_p source changed from 'this work' to [124]

keys renamed to American spelling (source.digitisation_method -> source.digitization_method, data_licence -> data_license); the digitization method now names both stages of digitize_perin2019.py; McCumber consistency statement set to the script values (300 K, 1500-1565 nm: within 1.6 % with the crossing wavelength 1533.5 nm of that range; free-temperature fit 293.2 K, 0.065 %); band-median deviation and a note added to the McCumber test record; free-temperature fit residuals given to two significant digits (0.018 and 0.065 %)
history.numeric_values_changed: none (entry values unchanged; verification record only)
